topics.topic: Authority model for draft-write effect attempts/resumes (is FlowActivation sufficient and what authority is recorded)
questions: When resuming a `service_unreachable` `draft-write` element (not a post-`not_applied` resend), is FlowActivation sufficient authority without approval/grant?
When recording in-flight EffectAttempt for ordinary `draft-write` sends, what authority value is written?

quotes:
Resume, by the owner or an agent, sends again, in (`node_id`, `map_index`) order — an element without `map_index` before index 0 — every element waiting on `service_unreachable`. Each is reached again by the order of A11 rule 1, so its authority is checked as it stands at the resume: its unused approval
   (M24), which is used first when both exist, or a grant still active; an element whose grant was revoked meanwhile
   waits for approval instead.

A `draft-write` send records as its authority the FlowActivation M18 of the run's version, except a resend after
   `not_applied`, which records its fresh approval; a `read` send has no
   EffectAttempt.

then, for an operation other than `read`, one store call
   writes the EffectAttempt `in_flight`, naming the approval or grant it uses;
judgement.why: One passage requires resume-time authority to be approval or grant, while another says ordinary `draft-write` sends use flow activation as authority and A11 still says non-read in-flight attempts name approval or grant.

topics.topic: Behavior when compose/prove references a missing contract_version_id or binding_id (reject upfront vs persist and fail proof)
questions: If a compose-and-prove request contains a node that names a non-existent contract_version_id or binding_id, must the kernel keep the FlowVersion and return a proof failure, or refuse the request as unknown reference before keeping anything?

topics.topic: Exact byte scope and enforcement stage for MCP request-size limits
questions: Exactly what byte range is counted for the ceiling in MCP: only the decoded operation payload, or full transport/frame bytes (including protocol envelope), and at what parsing stage must refusal happen?

topics.topic: Fallback outcome classification when transport cannot determine whether first request byte was sent
questions: If the HTTP stack cannot reliably tell whether the first request byte was written, which side of the table must be used?

topics.topic: Formal parsing/validation rules for A09 path placeholders and which malformed paths invalidate a binding
questions: How exactly is `{name}` parsed in declared paths (valid name characters, escaped braces, unmatched braces, repeated placeholders), and which malformed forms make a binding non-invocable at proposal time?

topics.topic: Handling oversized non-2xx service responses at service_response_bytes_max (ceiling failure vs truncate-and-map)
questions: When a non-2xx response body exceeds `service_response_bytes_max`, is that a size failure due to ceiling breach, or should reading stop at the ceiling and outcome mapping continue as in A09 without a separate ceiling failure?

topics.topic: Meaning of 'reaches' in A05 phase 9 (structural reachability vs guard-feasible reachability)
questions: Does "reaches" mean purely structural graph reachability, or only reachability through at least one guard-enabled path that can actually fire?

topics.topic: Precedence of purpose-consistency checks relative to schema validation and authorization in create requests
questions: For create-slot/create-flow requests, is purpose consistency checked before schema validation and authorization, or only inside operation-specific checks after them?

topics.topic: Semantics of explicitly empty try-case selection (run all vs invalid empty selection)
questions: Does an explicitly present empty case list count as "names none" (run all), or as an invalid empty selection/refusal?

topics.topic: Whether a now-mismatched approved approval is consumed when a standing grant authorizes the send
questions: If owner approves a pending approval but request_digest no longer matches and a standing grant covers the node, does the send consume that approval or leave it approved+unused while sending under the grant?
